name: Files
summary: Browse, search, tag and edit the folders this Studio binds. An agent can open a file here for you.

surface.hint: browse, search, tag and edit your files; the agent can drive it

_roots_note: No one root is required: a Studio binds whichever of these kinds it has (a hosted box binds media and work), and the page lists the folders it was given. With none bound it says so and offers to add one.
_focus_note: The page also posts /api/focus, which the Studio runtime itself serves. It is not listed in calls{}, because calls{} names verbs a provider must answer, and a runtime-owned verb listed there as required would make the Studio refuse to start.
